title: Inflationary Flows: Calibrated Bayesian Inference with Diffusion-Based Models

layout.note: Three unframed columns with bold titles; each holds three snapshots stepping down along a diagonal flanked by two parallel arrows, and an equation row below; thick block arrows between the outer columns and the middle one at the snapshot level and again at the equation level.

lesson: To show that several descriptions of one process are equivalent but behave differently, draw the same coloured toy set at the same three times in each column and print each column's governing equation underneath; tracer colours make the qualitative difference visible.
